capabilities: Draw rectangles, ellipses, arrows and auto-numbered markers on images
Pixelate sensitive parts of an image
Open the editor from a hover button, context menu or command palette command
Overwrite the original image or save a marked copy and update embeds
Configure default color, line width, save mode and interface language
extras: Warns that overwriting an image destroys the previous version unless a backup (File Recovery, Sync, git) exists; notes EXIF metadata is stripped on save, images over 16 megapixels are refused on iOS, and the plugin is installable via BRAT before community-list acceptance.
motivation: The README's 'Why' section says marking screenshots in a separate editor, exporting and re-embedding breaks your flow, so the author built in-note editing that saves straight back into the vault.
problem: Annotating a screenshot normally means opening a separate image editor, exporting, and re-embedding the file, which breaks the writing flow.
summary: Image annotation plugin that lets you draw rectangles, ellipses, arrows, numbered markers and pixelation on images directly inside notes and save them back to the vault.
